verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity and access management platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers and calls their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows Okta publishing its own MCP server and offering Cross App Access for authorizing agent-to-app connections. Both are server-side or authorization roles that belong to other stories and do not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
